eps.ov: Touka Scott doesn't care much about the devils supposedly ravaging the world... until a visit from the legendary hero changes everything.
The new hero's party heads out on a devil-hunting quest, but questions arise about new companion Kyle's motivations.

eps.t: The Legendary Hero Is a Skeleton!
eps.ov: Touka might have thought that his situation couldn't get any worse now that he's a zombie, but he was wrong.
Touka tries to keep up his masquerade around the princess, while a sinister plot moves into motion beneath the capital.
Touka and his makeshift party tackle the true terror haunting the capital.

eps.t: The Legendary Hero Is a Girl
eps.ov: A strange spell turning the townspeople into monsters forces some hard decisions from the hero's party.
As Touka and his friends pursue the entity enslaving the townspeople, an encounter with another adventurers' party raises new questions.

eps.t: The Legendary Hero Is a Student!
eps.ov: The wicked necromancers hire a deadly mercenary to slow the party down, as new revelations arise about Touka's past.
Touka awakens in a familiar place—Is it the past? Is it a dream? Whatever it is, he’ll need to solve the mystery before time runs out for him and Yuna!

eps.t: The Raid of the Legendary Hero
eps.ov: The legendary hero's party finally reaches Elvania, while the king makes his own plans to stop the necromancers' plot.

eps.t: The Legendary Hero Fights to the Death!
eps.ov: It's all coming down to the big climactic battle. Can Touka defeat Diego and save Yuna before time runs out?!

eps.t: The Legendary Hero Is a Duo!
eps.ov: The situation is dire Touka still won't wake up, even as time ticks down. Will the day be saved, or will the legendary hero end up dead—again?
